trigger: Whiteout on the river: a mimic calls in Walt's voice (enc_ch09_hollow_ambush), then an assimilated coyote pack (enc_ch09_animal_pack).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Whiteout. The column moves rope to rope. Somewhere off the ice, to the left, a voice.

nodes.speaker: hollow
nodes.text: Braith? Over here. Over here. I found the trail. I found the trail, Braith.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It's Walt's voice. Walt is on the sled behind you, asleep under three blankets.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Planted. Hackles up. Growling at the voice. Then she looks at you: don't.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: No dog to ask. You stare into the white. Nothing out there is breathing steam.

nodes.speaker: column
nodes.text: [Someone down the line] That's the old man! He's out there! Somebody go get him!

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Thirty steps off the rope the voice stops. Two shapes stand up out of the snow, wrong at the knees.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You make it back to the rope. One of the column doesn't. Behind you, the voice starts saying their name.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Red light on the snow. Two figures, close. One wears a parka you saw at the bridge camp. You fire.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You walk. The voice walks with you for a mile, just off the rope: 'I found the trail.' Then it gives up.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Then the coyotes. Five of them in the ash, moving like one animal with too many legs.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Shoves herself between you and them. Silent. She knows these aren't coyotes anymore.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: No yips. No breath. They don't circle like dogs. They wait like people.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They come apart in the flarelight like something badly glued. Two stay down. The rest fade into the white.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The lamp holds them at the edge of the light for an hour. Then the wind shifts and they're gone.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: New rule, pass it down the line. Nobody answers a voice. Nobody. Not even mine.
